hunks.baseline: Along with the cheerful system notification, the sensations that had briefly slipped away began returning.
hunks.sol: With the cheerful System notification, the senses that had briefly left me began to return.

hunks.baseline: The softness of the bed against my back. The warm air inside the private jet.
hunks.sol: The softness of the bed beneath my back. The warm air inside the private jet.

hunks.baseline: And the hands gripping and shaking both my shoulders, along with the shouts that came with them.
hunks.sol: And the hands gripping both my shoulders and shaking me, accompanied by frantic shouts.

hunks.baseline: I blinked at the urgent voices drilling into my ears—two voices, no, one monster’s and one human’s.
hunks.sol: I blinked at the two urgent voices drilling into my ears—no, one human voice and one monster voice.

hunks.baseline: - Well done! You’re a slightly less vile human now!
hunks.sol: - Well done, slightly less vile human!

hunks.baseline: After taking an unexpected slap across the face, I answered in a dazed voice.
hunks.sol: Stunned by the unexpected slap across the face, I answered in a daze.

hunks.baseline: “What is wrong with you? I tried so hard to wake you up, so why are you only getting up now?”
hunks.sol: “What is wrong with you? We tried everything to wake you! Why are you only getting up now?”

hunks.baseline: Talk about force. This was the first time I’d ever seen Team Leader Choi this furious.
hunks.sol: Damn, he was intense. This was the first time I’d ever seen Team Leader Choi this furious.

hunks.baseline: No matter what happened, Team Leader Choi had always kept his composure while showing off his designer goods. But lightning was practically shooting from his eyes.
hunks.sol: No matter what happened, Team Leader Choi always kept his composure and bragged about his designer goods. Now, lightning was practically shooting from his eyes.

hunks.baseline: I had apologized on instinct, but I was still bewildered. Was this really something worth getting slapped over?
hunks.sol: I had apologized on instinct, but I was still bewildered. Was this really worth slapping me over?

hunks.baseline: That was when—
hunks.sol: Then—

hunks.baseline: Team Leader Choi’s voice was swallowed by the flight attendants’ screams. The shouts of men who were probably the pilots followed.
hunks.sol: Team Leader Choi’s voice was drowned out by the flight attendants’ screams. The shouts of men I assumed were the pilots followed.

hunks.baseline: What on earth was happening?
hunks.sol: What the hell was going on?

hunks.baseline: As I frantically looked around, Team Leader Choi delivered an unbelievable statement.
hunks.sol: As I frantically looked around, Team Leader Choi hit me with an unbelievable statement.

hunks.baseline: What kind of bullshit was that? We were flying at twenty-five thousand feet in a private jet sent by the Central Committee of China.
hunks.sol: What kind of bullshit was that? We were flying at twenty-five thousand feet in a private jet sent by the Chinese Central Committee.

hunks.baseline: By now, it wouldn’t have been strange for our destination, Chengdu International Airport in Sichuan Province, to come into view…
hunks.sol: By now, it wouldn’t have been strange for our destination, Chengdu International Airport in Sichuan Province, to have come into view…

hunks.baseline: I unconsciously turned toward the window—and stared with my mouth hanging open.
hunks.sol: I turned toward the window—and stared with my mouth hanging open.

hunks.baseline: Far below, a massive airport stretched across the ground. Flames surged into the sky, while large and small dots moved through the chaos.
hunks.sol: Far below, flames surged from the sprawling airport as dots large and small moved amid the chaos.

hunks.baseline: It was a battle. A deadly battle between humans and monsters.
hunks.sol: It was a battle. Humans and monsters were locked in a fight to the death.

hunks.baseline: The enormous body of a monster was rapidly closing in on the private jet I was riding in.
hunks.sol: The enormous body of a monster was rapidly closing in on our private jet.

hunks.baseline: An A-rank monster classified as part of the dragonkin alongside drakes.
hunks.sol: An A-rank monster classified as dragonkin alongside drakes.

hunks.baseline: And there were around a dozen of them!
hunks.sol: And there were more than ten of them!

hunks.baseline: A fierce battle was raging around Chengdu International Airport below, while a flock of wyverns chased the private jet carrying me through the sky.
hunks.sol: A fierce battle was raging around Chengdu International Airport below, while a flock of wyverns chased my private jet through the sky.

hunks.baseline: There was no doubt about it. The supreme undead monster that had appeared alongside an unprecedented monster wave one week ago in modern-world time had extended its reach this far.
hunks.sol: There was no doubt about it. The top-tier undead monster that had appeared with an unprecedented monster wave one week ago in modern-world time had already extended its reach this far.

hunks.baseline: Screams and shouts rained down from every direction as humans and monsters alike fell into a panic.
hunks.sol: Screams and shouts rained down from every direction as humans and monster alike descended into panic.

hunks.baseline: Only one person among them managed to retain his sanity.
hunks.sol: Only one person among them retained his composure.

hunks.baseline: “Everyone, calm down! The thing you’re afraid of won’t happen!”
hunks.sol: “Everyone, calm down! What you’re afraid of won’t happen!”

hunks.baseline: As expected of Team Leader Choi. He was reliable.
hunks.sol: As expected of Team Leader Choi. Reliable as ever.

hunks.baseline: He had obviously thought of a way to overcome this crisis.
hunks.sol: He had obviously thought of a way out of this crisis.

hunks.baseline: “Mr. Jin Taekyung here will solve it!”
hunks.sol: “Mr. Jin Taekyung here will take care of it!”

hunks.baseline: “I trust Mr. Jin Taekyung!”
hunks.sol: “I trust you, Mr. Jin Taekyung!”

hunks.baseline: Why did he trust me?
hunks.sol: Why the hell did he trust me?

hunks.baseline: In a situation like this, believing in God, Buddha, or Allah would probably be more helpful.
hunks.sol: In a situation like this, putting his faith in God, Buddha, or Allah would probably help more.

hunks.baseline: I was momentarily speechless as people’s gazes came flying toward me from all sides.
hunks.sol: As I stood there speechless, everyone’s gaze snapped toward me.

hunks.baseline: “Come to think of it, I’ve heard about that Hunter. They say he’s so formidable that even Comrade Chairman Xiao Yang made a special request for him.”
hunks.sol: “Come to think of it, I’ve heard about that Hunter. They say he’s so formidable that even Comrade Chairman Xiao Yang personally requested his help.”

hunks.baseline: - You vile human! I knew you were strong, but you’re beyond my wildest imagination! Rejoice, my legion. Your commander has survived!
hunks.sol: - You vile human! I knew you were strong, but you’re beyond my wildest imagination! Rejoice, my legion! Your commander has survived!

hunks.baseline: “Your attitude, tone of voice, and expression in a situation like this. All of them are grounds for my trust.”
hunks.sol: “Your attitude, tone of voice, and expression in a situation like this. All of them give me reason to trust you.”

hunks.baseline: I was strong. Stronger than ever. Strong enough to avoid any danger.
hunks.sol: I was strong. Stronger than ever. Strong enough to make it through any danger.

hunks.baseline: I muttered quietly to myself before opening my mouth.
hunks.sol: I muttered under my breath, then spoke up.

hunks.baseline: It was trembling violently. With his other hand, the captain was probably gripping the controls for dear life, desperately trying to evade the wyverns lunging at us.
hunks.sol: It was trembling violently. His other hand must have been gripping the controls for dear life as he desperately tried to evade the wyverns lunging at us.

hunks.baseline: The captain must have been so shocked that he poked his head out and stared at me as though I were insane.
hunks.sol: The captain was so shocked that he poked his head out and stared at me as if I were insane.

hunks.baseline: “Of course not! Not only is it impossible to open because of the pressure-sealing system, the aircraft will be damaged because it can’t withstand the pressure difference! You won’t even be able to breathe properly!”
hunks.sol: “Of course not! The pressure-sealing system won’t even let you open it, and the aircraft will break apart if it’s exposed to the pressure difference! We won’t be able to breathe properly, either!”

hunks.baseline: Team Leader Choi, fiddling with the ring on his finger, cut in.
hunks.sol: Team Leader Choi fiddled with the ring on his finger and cut in.

hunks.baseline: “I think I can block the pressure. I don’t know what you have in mind, but go ahead and try.”
hunks.sol: “I think I can hold back the pressure. I don’t know what you have in mind, but go ahead and try.”

hunks.baseline: The nerve of him, insulting Koreans right in front of a proud Korean kimchi man like me!
hunks.sol: The nerve of him, insulting Koreans in front of a proud Korean kimchi man like me!

hunks.baseline: Realizing the slip of the tongue that had escaped him, the captain’s face turned pale.
hunks.sol: The captain realized what had slipped out, and his face turned white.

hunks.baseline: “You fucking Chink bastard. Damn it.”
hunks.sol: “You fucking Chink bastard. Why, I ought to…”

hunks.baseline: “Ah! Ah!”
hunks.sol: “Ah! Ahhh!”

hunks.baseline: Before the captain had time to stop me, I opened the door.
hunks.sol: Before the captain could stop me, I opened the door.

hunks.baseline: No—I cut it open.
hunks.sol: No—I cut one open.

hunks.baseline: Sword qi—the force called an Aura Blade in the modern world—sliced through the sturdy alloy and created a small door.
hunks.sol: Sword qi—the force known as an Aura Blade in the modern world—sliced through the sturdy alloy, creating a small doorway.

hunks.baseline: Just as a Supreme Peak master of the Murim could do, it was a tremendous power that only an S-rank Hunter could display here.
hunks.sol: It was the tremendous power wielded by Supreme Peak masters in Murim and, in this world, only by S-rank Hunters.

hunks.baseline: This was no time to be surprised. The tremendous wind and pressure were making the aircraft lurch, turning the cabin into a complete mess.
hunks.sol: This was no time to be surprised. The tremendous wind and pressure made the aircraft lurch, throwing the cabin into chaos.

hunks.baseline: Team Leader Choi came to his senses at the screams and my shout, then rubbed his ring.
hunks.sol: The screams and my shout snapped Team Leader Choi back to his senses. He rubbed his ring.

hunks.baseline: “An impenetrable barrier surrounds us. Barrier!”
hunks.sol: “An airtight barrier surrounds us. Barrier!”

hunks.baseline: Along with the incantation, a transparent membrane of energy sealed off the new opening without leaving so much as a gap.
hunks.sol: With the incantation, a transparent membrane of energy sealed the new opening without leaving the slightest gap.

hunks.baseline: Because Team Leader Choi’s barrier recognized me as an ally, it let me pass through without resistance.
hunks.sol: Team Leader Choi’s barrier recognized me as an ally and let me pass through without resistance.

hunks.baseline: Rumble, rumble!
hunks.sol: Rrrrrumble!

hunks.baseline: The wind pressure slammed into my upper body as though trying to crush me. I grinned.
hunks.sol: The wind pressure battered my upper body as if trying to crush me to death. I grinned.

hunks.baseline: But it wasn’t unbearable.
hunks.sol: But it wasn’t more than I could handle.

hunks.baseline: Actually, it would have been strange if I couldn’t withstand it. Compared to the waves of qi the Western Heaven Demon Lord had emitted, this was no more than a gentle spring breeze.
hunks.sol: In fact, it would have been strange if I couldn’t withstand it. Compared to the waves of qi the Western Heaven Demon Lord had unleashed, this was no more than a gentle spring breeze.

hunks.baseline: The monster’s sharp cry mixed into that spring breeze.
hunks.sol: A monster’s piercing shriek mingled with that spring breeze.

hunks.baseline: *About a hundred meters. I’ve never tried this before, but… at this distance, it should be enough.*
hunks.sol: *About a hundred meters. I’ve never tried this before, but… this should be close enough.*

hunks.baseline: *Open inventory. Equip.*
hunks.sol: *Open Inventory. Equip.*

hunks.baseline: Like a javelin thrower, I drew my shoulder far back. From my waist to my wrist, the necessary muscles and tendons pulled taut like bowstrings.
hunks.sol: Like a javelin thrower, I drew my shoulder all the way back. From my waist to my wrist, every muscle and tendon I needed pulled taut like a bowstring.

hunks.baseline: The leading wyvern, their chief, noticed that something was wrong and threw back its head with a shriek.
hunks.sol: The lead wyvern—their chief—sensed something was wrong and threw back its head with a shriek.

hunks.baseline: I could see a pure-white current of air being sucked toward its snout.
hunks.sol: A pure-white current of air rushed toward its maw.

hunks.baseline: - Breath! It’s using Breath! Dodge it, you vile human!
hunks.sol: - Breath! It’s Breath! Dodge it, you vile human!

hunks.baseline: Among the countless monsters, Breath was a power granted only to the dragonkin. Inside the wyvern’s wide-open maw, I could clearly see it taking shape.
hunks.sol: Of all the countless monsters, Breath was a power granted only to the dragonkin. I could clearly see it taking shape inside the wyvern’s gaping maw.

hunks.baseline: A massive sphere of wind. An air breath capable of shredding metal like paper had formed completely.
hunks.sol: A massive sphere of wind. The Air Breath, powerful enough to shred metal like paper, finished taking shape.

hunks.baseline: - Kya?
hunks.sol: - Kyaau?

hunks.baseline: Fiery concentrated qi sheathed the spearhead, burning the air and cleaving the wind.
hunks.sol: Fiery concentrated qi sheathed the spearhead, burning through the air and cleaving the wind.

hunks.baseline: Compressed air burst from the tip of the spear. A cloud of white.
hunks.sol: Compressed air exploded at the tip of the spear. A cloud of white.

hunks.baseline: A massive body plunged toward the ground like a kite with its string cut.
hunks.sol: A massive body plummeted toward the ground like a kite with its string cut.

hunks.baseline: Around a dozen pairs of bright yellow eyes stared at one another.
hunks.sol: More than ten pairs of bright yellow eyes stared at one another.

hunks.baseline: Wyverns were ferocious creatures from the moment they were born, but at this moment, they were utterly bewildered and had no idea what to do.
hunks.sol: Wyverns were ferocious creatures from the moment they were born, but at that moment, they were utterly bewildered and had no idea what to do.

hunks.baseline: Their leader was an exceptionally powerful member of their species—so powerful that he was known as the “Black Star.”
hunks.sol: Their leader was exceptionally powerful even among their own kind—so powerful that he was known as the “Black Star.”

hunks.baseline: None of them had even properly seen how he died.
hunks.sol: None of them had even seen how he died.

hunks.baseline: How could a mere human dare lay a hand on a descendant of the great dragons…
hunks.sol: How could a mere human dare lay a hand on a descendant of the great dragons…?

hunks.baseline: This time, they saw it clearly: their companion’s head bursting apart in the beam of light.
hunks.sol: This time, they saw it clearly—their companion’s head bursting apart in the beam of light.

hunks.baseline: They would get their revenge later. A little later.
hunks.sol: They would take revenge later. A little later.

hunks.baseline: *…Will they ever get their revenge?*
hunks.sol: *…Would they ever get their revenge?*

hunks.baseline: Around a dozen pairs of wings began flapping desperately.
hunks.sol: More than ten pairs of wings began flapping desperately.
